definitions.explanation: A photograph one takes of oneself, usually with a smartphone. Borrowed from English and used mainly in fashion, beauty, and social-media writing; in everyday Japanese {自撮|じど}り is far more common.

examples.japanese: ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧セルフィー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: I took a selfie with a friend.

examples.japanese: セルフィー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{撮|と}れる→撮る：00760_toru⟧⟦アプリ→アプリ：04722_apuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use an app that takes good selfies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{展望台|てんぼうだい}→展望台：18278_tenboudai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜景|やけい}→夜景：10434_yakei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{背景|はいけい}→背景：28348_haikei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧セルフィー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: At the observation deck, I took a selfie with the city's night view behind me.

notes:
From English 'selfie'. It reads as somewhat stylish or media-flavored; a learner who wants the neutral everyday word should use ⟦{自撮|じど}り→自撮り：16863_jidori⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- セルフィー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧: to take a selfie
- セルフィー⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧: a self-filmed video
- セルフィー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{投稿|とうこう}する→投稿する：18994_toukousuru⟧: to post a selfie

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自撮|じど}り→自撮り：16863_jidori⟧: selfie — the standard Japanese word; also used as a verb with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧
- ⟦{自撮|じど}り{棒|ぼう}→自撮り棒：30460_jidoribou⟧: selfie stick — always formed on ⟦{自撮|じど}り→自撮り：16863_jidori⟧, never on セルフィー
